issues.description: The expected return type of messageOnMilk() is inconsistent across the problem statement and the solution. The textual description and one place in the UML indicate a boolean return (e.g. "should return true if milking was successful, false otherwise"), while other parts of the UML and the provided solution define messageOnMilk() as returning a String (and implementations return messages like "Seal X is milked"). This mismatch can confuse students about whether to implement messageOnMilk() to return a boolean or a String and will lead to compilation/signature errors if they follow one source but tests/solution expect the other.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type for messageOnMilk() consistent across the specification, template, and solution. Preferably align with the other 'messageOn...' methods (which return String) by updating the problem text and UML to require messageOnMilk(): String and change the explanatory text to ask for a milking message (e.g. "return a String describing the milking result"). Alternatively, if a boolean is intended, change the solution interface and all implementations to return boolean and update tests accordingly.
